title: A route into the codebase
summary:
A small community-maintenance day: clearer codebase guidance, more projects in the catalog, and a tidier Claude workflow.

Sequa AI's Pollinations codebase-knowledge MCP URL was added to the README, website news, and MCP guidance, making the connection easier for contributors to find.

The project catalog gained entries including websim-pollinations-ai and Visiora. The website also gained a projects anchor and listed NavyAI and Nebius as supporters.

The Claude workflow now permits `mcp_sequa_search_web` instead of `web_search`, and the separate automated Claude PR-review workflow was removed.
